{{Quote|It's a system we cannot afford to lose.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The '''Kashyyyk system''', known by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] as the '''Hsskassi system''', was located in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

==History==
[[File:TrandoshaWasskah-PL.png|thumb|left|250px|Trandosha and its moon Wasskah were also located in the Kashyyyk system]]
The [[Star system/Legends|solar system]] contained the inhabited [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], home of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]],<ref name="SWHS" /> and [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]], home of the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]]. It also contained the Wookiee colony moon of [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], orbiting the gas giant [[Alaris]],<ref name="GB" /> as well as the Trandoshan moon of [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]], where Trandoshans hunted various species captured around the galaxy for sport.<ref name="EGWH">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode322.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Wookiee Hunt}}</ref> The Trandoshans knew it as the Hsskassi system, but the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] would call it the Kashyyyk system when the Wookiees became its first, and sole, representatives in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]].<ref name="Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook>[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> The system was relatively isolated as it was far from the central trade routes, although it was located close to a major route for the southwestern quadrant, and was home to an important [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] navigation and communication relay station.

During the beginning of the [[Jedi Civil War]], Kashyyyk was controlled by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]], who had struck a deal with the corrupt Wookiee chieftain [[Chuundar]] and enslaved the Wookiee population to run an illegal slave-trade operation out of the planet. The amnesiac [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], aided by his Wookiee life-debtor and brother of Chuundar, [[Zaalbar]], overthrew Chuundar and incited the planet-wide [[Rebellion on Kashyyyk/Legends|Rebellion on Kashyyyk]], forcing Czerka to abandon their slave-trade operation and leave the system.

The Wookiees and Trandoshans of the system were locked in a bitter rivalry for centuries. During the waning days of the Republic, this became a pressure point when debate arose over which planet's representative would be chosen as the system's [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

During the [[New Sith Wars]], a [[Skirmish on Alaris Prime|skirmish]] took place on [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] in [[1002 BBY]].<ref name="Bane">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]'' describes a [[Skirmish on Alaris Prime|skirmish]] occurring on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] one [[Standard month/Legends|month]] after [[Darth Bane/Legends|Dessel's]] expulsion from the [[Gloom Walkers]], which in turn took place one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the beginning of the main events of ''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]'' and thereby corresponds to [[1002 BBY]], according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''. Therefore, Alaris Prime's disappearance from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] view, as described in the DataBank of ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', must have occurred after 1002 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> [[Time/Legends|Sometime]] later, Alaris Prime became lost to galactic view for [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]] made trips to the moon during his adolesence.<ref name="Bounty">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref> Between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Alaris Prime colonial war]] as portrayed in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. ''Galactic Battlegrounds'' stated that the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] took twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] to distribute the colonization rights after Alaris Prime was [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|discovered]], indicating that the discovery took place between [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]]</ref> Alaris Prime was rediscovered by Wookiee [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] from Kashyyyk, beginning a lengthy debate in the Senate over colonization rights. The Wookiees were represented by [[Wookiee Chieftain|Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], and were opposed by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation of Planets]], who wanted to use Alaris Prime as a way-station between Kashyyyk, [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], and [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]]. The Republic ultimately [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|gave the rights]] to the Wookiees after twenty years of debate.<ref name="GB" />

Between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]],<ref name="New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Alaris Prime colonists|Wookiee colonists]], led by Attichitcuk in honor of his senatorial representation, travelled through the [[Alaris Expanse]] to Alaris Prime aboard the ''[[Thalmussen]]'' and three other [[Colony ship/Legends|colony ships]]. The Trade Federation also secretly arrived on Alaris Prime to launch their own illegal colonization effort, arriving shortly before the Wookiees. The Wookiees discovered the Trade Federation's presence when both groups [[Skirmish at the gundark nest|clashed]] at a [[Unidentified gundark nest|nest]] of [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]]. This lead to a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] between the two factions for control of the moon, which the Wookiees eventually [[Battle for Alaris Prime|won]].<ref name="GB" />
